object_description: three connected volumes of differentiated heights embedded in a garden setting
design_condition: Three connected volumes follow the surrounding buildings and site levels, preserve the existing garden and trees, and use inclined and stepped paths to embed the structure in the ensemble.

positive.statement: The three connected volumes enable high-quality urban development and respect the existing buildings to a high degree.
The differentiated heights form an appropriate counterpart to neighboring buildings.
The facade design responds sensitively to the surroundings through differentiated articulation.
The preserved and supplemented planting ties the open-space design sensitively to the existing garden.
The clear outside-space structure continues into a clear internal organization with generously sized access areas.
The arrangement of uses ensures an optimal operational process for different user groups.
The surrounding lighting of the sports hall is viewed positively.
The stacked sports rooms enable an efficient construction method.
The dismantling and reusability requirements are taken seriously and consistently met.
All rooms are naturally lit and ventilated, and the generous window proportion is viewed positively.
The project has very good construction economics.

negative.statement: The terrain subsidence along the northeastern and northwestern facades does not yet achieve harmonious integration.
The path to the main entrance should be more clearly highlighted and better developed as barrier-free access.
Free-standing supports in the multifunctional rooms are operationally impossible and must be rearranged.
The equipment room is inconveniently located because it can only be reached through the corridor.
The cloakroom space is generally too limited.
The east-side main staircase should be integrated into the heated usage area for operational reasons.
Without summer thermal protection, glare and overheating must be checked.
The stacked ventilation centers do not meet the standard of well-coordinated simplicity.
The hot-water storage arrangement is unfavorable for hygienic reasons and should be replaced.
